messages:
Jamie: heads-up — nightly perf alert for eu-west region: p95 latency up ~28% since the 12:30 deploy. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/nightly/eu-west :eyes:
Dmitri: saw the alert too. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~155ms on the streaming path. traces point at kernel-selection changes (new weighting) + batching window widening.
Ashok: can you paste the nightly perf summary? any KV miss spike? batching/queue stats?
Jamie: paste from alert logs:
```
2024-06-15 00:30:12 ALERT p95_latency: 155ms (baseline 121ms)
kv_miss_rate: 4.8% -> 9.1%
batch_window_ms: 12 -> 20
kernel_choice: switched to kernel-v2-weighted
hotpath_tail: increased
```
Olivia: kv_miss doubling is suspicious — could be cache eviction heuristic change in the same merge. do we have the PRs that went out at 12:25?
Dmitri: quick grep of the deploy manifest: merged PRs: #4321 (kernel selector refactor), #4319 (batcher: adaptive window), #4317 (kv: eviction thresholds). All released in the same deploy.
QA-Bot: CI perf job failed on the post-merge run: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/bench/nightly-latency/2024-06-15 — p95 regression reproduced on bench harness :x:
Ashok: let's bisect the three PRs. I'll run a perf bisect across the deploy window.
Dmitri: I started a local perf run against the production trace set. small script:
```
./scripts/perf-bisect --range=main~5..main --metric=p95 --workload=streaming-eu-west
```
Dmitri: preliminary results point at commit 7a3c9f4 (part of #4321) as the first commit where p95 jumps.
Jamie: logs from that commit show kernel selection now prefers kernel-v2 for sequences >128 and increases batch window target. might explain combined effect.
Olivia: can we test reverting only the kernel-selector change (keep batcher + kv) to isolate? if p95 falls back we're golden.
Dmitri: did a quick revert locally of 7a3c9f4 and re-ran the harness — p95 back to 122ms, kv_miss_rate back to ~5%. That strongly implicates the kernel selector change affecting cache affinity / hotset locality.
Ashok: good catch. propose we roll back the kernel selector change in prod and hold a patch PR to rework the selector heuristics. I'll open the rollback PR now.
Jamie: yay, please tag oncall and set rollout hold. @oncall :alarm_clock:
Olivia: created rollback PR #4335 (revert commit 7a3c9f4) and started a canary. monitoring the canary now.
QA-Bot: CI bench run on revert PR shows p95 recovered in the job results: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/bench/nightly-latency/4335 :white_check_mark:
Dmitri: canary looks healthy — p95 in canary replicas matched baseline after revert. will follow up with flamegraphs to understand why kernel-v2 shift increased KV thrash.
Jamie: next steps: 1) Rollback merged (in progress), 2) Open follow-up issue to red-team selector heuristics + add unit perf tests, 3) Add regression guard in CI to fail merges that increase kv_miss_rate > 2x in nightly harness.
Olivia: filed follow-up: INTERNAL-1254 'kernel-selector-affinity-regression' and assigned to Ashok/Dmitri. Added a CI perf gate task.
Ashok: thanks everyone — keeping rollout on hold until we confirm stable for 30m. will post final update when we promote.
Jamie: thanks :thumbsup: — saved the night. closing triage but leaving ticket open for estimator improvements.
